newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Airlines extends fare promotion.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Airlines extends fare promotion.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Tuesday it is extending its "Half-Price for Half-Pints" sale through April 30.

The fare promotion offers half-price tickets for seats purchased for a child 12 years of age or younger, the carrier said. Reservations must be made at least one day in advance for travel through October 1, and the child must be accompanied by a fare-paying adult on the same itenerary.
Vanguard is a passenger carrier offering flights to 13 cities.
